tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, and development builds get no exception: they verify certificates exactly as release builds do.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement of the recorded decision. It says certificate verification stays on for all builds, with no exception for development builds.

That comes from the recorded decision "Keep verification on all builds, no exceptions for development" (#34). I left out the earlier idea of disabling verification in dev builds, since that was retired.

A later message said plain HTTP is fine for internal hosts. That is only a note in the session history, not a recorded decision, and it conflicts with #34. I didn't put it in the document. If internal hosts are meant to be an exception, that needs to be recorded as a decision first.

Muninn also reported a red heartbeat: 20 hook runs started and never finished. This didn't affect the file, but it may be worth checking `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
